A business built from who you actually are.
An income that funds the life you are here to live.

A business built from your gifts. Income generated from who you actually are. Work that feels sacred because it is. A life outside the ordinary. Free, in nature, on your own terms. Not the life that was handed to you. The one you chose. The one that is completely yours.

I know what it takes to build that life because I built it. Not from a course. Not from a certification. From years in the Andes, from ceremonies in the Amazon forest and in the Sacred Valley, from mountains climbed alone at altitude. And from years of professional work in marketing, social media, and personal brand building — with entrepreneurs who had the calling and needed someone who could translate it into a business that actually generates income.

I am here to help visionary entrepreneurs do the same. To build a brand that reflects who they actually are. To generate the income that funds the mission. To create a life where what they are here to do and what they do every day are the same thing.

That is the crossing. That is what I stand for.

— About Francesco

I rebuilt my worth from zero.
Now I help others climb theirs and build the vehicle to expand their impact.

I know what it means to lose your sense of worth completely. Because it happened to me.

Two years of bullying left me without an identity. I did not know who I was anymore. I did not know what I was worth. Everything that made me who I was had been systematically destroyed. What remained was someone who had forgotten how to take up space.

The way back was slow. It started with a daily practice. Meditation. Showing up to myself every single day, even when I could not feel anything. Slowly, something returned. A sense of purpose. A feeling of potential. A power I had not felt in years.

Then came the ceremonies. And with them, a clarity I had never had before.

From that place, I started building. My personal brand. My business. A vehicle through which I could help others do the same. To find their voice. To expand their impact. To rise and create a wave of transformation that does not stop with them.

That is what I am here to build with you.
